reviews.text: I deeply regret choosing your restaurant. The quality of the food was terrible. The female waitress who took our order was extremely rude and showed no respect towards the customers. What was even more disturbing was the male waiter who was serving the food. His hygiene was absolutely unacceptable. On two separate occasions, I saw him serving food to the table next to mine while he had his hand down the back of his trousers, scratching his backside. It was honestly disgusting and completely inappropriate, especially for someone handling and serving food. Although the restaurant itself appeared clean, the male waiter serving the food seemed to have no understanding of basic hygiene standards. I strongly urge the restaurant manager or owner to review the CCTV footage from 20:24 to 20:35 on Saturday, 26 September 2026. You should be able to clearly see what I witnessed, including the waiter putting his hand inside the back of his underwear and scratching himself while working. Overall, the entire experience was extremely disappointing and unacceptable.

reviews.author: prasenjeet motghare
reviews.text: Probably applies to takeaway only. Hate to give bad reviews but I think this one is deserved. I ordered takeaway couple of desserts and when they brought back food- I was told "sorry we don't give ice-cream with takeaway and I don't make rules" and didn't even offer me options to return or money back -so basically I paid 14.40 for small brownie (was dry) and 4 pieces of banana fitters! I asked if I could get extra tofu in miso soup as my child only eats that (while traveling) and person taking ordered seemed lost. And what l got is half a cup of soup with maybe 4 pieces of tofu- but it was delicious. It goes downhill from that- I asked if goyzo can be steamed instead of pan fried (which is standard across world/countries I have tried- and again explained that that is how my child eat it. Anyone who has kids may understand). I was told,"No changes in menu" and he snatched menu and said, "you done ordering "? Oh well. Seat in looked good- and suchi looked good BUT I left felt cheated!

reviews.text: This place was usually packed so we went at 5.30 for a chance to get in. Glad we did. Charming, elegant and stylish decor. A warm welcome, with excellent service throughout from attentive staff. We had tempura prawn, a Tokyo roll, He'll Ramen and a chicken dish with fried noodles. We enjoyed everything. Nicely presented, good size portions and full of flavour. Nice cocktails too. Reasonable prices and great value. I often say in reviews that we would return. This is somewhere we definitely WILL return. Only point on atmosphere. I liked the music but it didn't quite match the venue. Probably aimed at younger folks, which judging by the hundreds of positive post it messages round the walls are the main clientele.

reviews.text: DO NOT GO HERE IF VEGAN! Had a bad experience here. We’re all vegan and ordered “vegan” food off of the menu. 2 of us were served food covered in fish flakes. When we explained we didn’t eat fish and were vegan, we were told it was vegetarian (which is obviously isn’t). We explained it wasn’t and the food was remade but there was still fish flakes on the table after and we were left feeling distrustful and a bit sick. Neither of us could finish our food. When the waitress came to take our plates and ask if it was okay, we explained what had happened and said we weren’t happy, yet we were still charged full price for the meal. We won’t be coming here again and will be getting in touch with customer services.

I had the black garlic tonkotsu, which had a nice broth (could have been thicker) but was lacking a little on the black garlic imo. The menma was good, the noodles were well cooked, but the chasui was not great, and I'm not sure why crispy onions were on the bowl. It was okay overall. I also had some chicken gyoza, which were tasty but slightly cold. The dipping sauce also just tasted like plain say sauce, which was a bit of a disappointment. Service was fast and friendly.

reviews.author: Sara Maria Andres Hernandez
reviews.text: (Translated by Google) I usually really like ramen, but this one was a huge disappointment. There are tons of TikToks recommending it, but it's all fake advertising. The noodles were undercooked and didn't taste homemade at all. It was like they'd just been taken out of the bag and left on the plate to soak up the broth. The only thing that was good was the broth. The meat was unchewable; it formed two clumps in my mouth that I had to spit out into a napkin. For the price, Lanzhou nearby is a thousand times better—cheaper, and they make the noodles right in front of you; they taste great. (Original) Me gusta mucho el ramen normalmente, y este ha dejado mucho que desear. Hay muchos tiktoks recomendándolo y es mucha publicidad fake. Los fideos están poco hechos, y no saben a caseros. Parece que los hayan sacado de la bolsa y te los hayan dejado en el plato haciéndose con el caldo. Lo único que estaba de locos era el caldo. La carne no se podía masticar, se me hicieron dos bolas en la boca que tuve que escupir en una servilleta. Para el precio mil veces mejor el lanzhou que hay cerca, más barato y hacen los fideos delante de ti, saben muy bien.

reviews.author: Olayanju Biodun
reviews.text: Absolutely loved my experience at Maki & Ramen! The food was genuinely so good. I had the Tantanmen Ramen (I think that’s the name 😂) and it was packed with flavour so, easily one of the nicest ramen dishes I’ve had. Beating the drum every time a customer walks in and they found a table for them is absolutely hilarious and that makes the experience even great. I also tried the mochi ice cream, which was the perfect way to finish the meal. Everything tasted fresh, well prepared and full of flavour. The fact that they have halal options makes it even better. It’s not always easy finding somewhere that offers this kind of Japanese food while also catering to halal diners, so I really appreciated that. Great food, great experience and definitely somewhere I’d happily come back to. Highly recommended!

reviews.text: It was my first time visiting Maki Nori, and the omakase experience was truly outstanding. I’ve had omakase in many places—including Japan—and I can easily say this was one of my absolute favorites! The food was exceptionally fresh and delicious, set inside a cozy restaurant with a vibrant atmosphere. A special mention to the General Manager Ginger, what a lovely person! He is incredibly knowledgeable about Japanese cuisine, highly professional, and so friendly. I highly recommend this spot and will definitely be back!

reviews.author: Vincent Lao
reviews.text: First meal eating out after being away from London. Finally back to having one of my favourite Asian food, Japanese 🍣 We ordered their: - Chef's selection 15 pcs Omakase - 5 Hand Rolls Sets - Black Dragon (Eel) Roll - Snow Crab California Roll - Wagu Truffle Maki Roll - Chef's Ceviche - Prawn Tempera - Grilled Aubergene

reviews.author: Payton Godlewski
reviews.text: I had such an amazing time here! The sushi is super high-quality and fairly affordable as well. One of the sushi chefs, Victoria, took the time to tell us all about where they sourced the fish and chat about her experience as a sushi chef! Couldn’t recommend this place more! Best sushi in London!!

reviews.author: Huw Siddle
reviews.text: The food was delicious and very interesting - the Tokusei menu was simple but very tasty, and the crudo and roll menus provided some interesting more out-there options, but the service was the highlight by far. Victoria specifically took the time out of her prep to answer a lot of our questions about the dishes and where they come from, which was absolutely above and beyond!

reviews.author: Arianna Leardini
reviews.text: What a surprise, this little restaurant has some really fantastic dishes. The “Crudo” are my favourites but the fried chicken too. Staff very professional and friendly, first time I tried Sake and the Jinger guy has great recommendations.

reviews.author: Olimpia Bernasconi
reviews.text: Impressive venue, very minimal but stylish!! The food is spectacular and tasty, the service refined and caring! The guy with the big moustaches definitely knows the menu, and can definitely give you some good advices. Great sake selection too!!! I will be back for more!!!

reviews.author: wing in lee
reviews.text: The chef is amazing, all the ingredients are very fresh

reviews.author: Zoe Chater

reviews.author: Ellie Danemann
reviews.text: Literally 10/10 cannot recommend enough!!

reviews.author: Lara Conradie
reviews.text: Everything was 10/10 - exceptionally delicious cannot fault anything. Will be back!

reviews.author: Brandon Lewis
reviews.text: Exceptional quality and service! My friends and I are big sushi fans, and this was hands down the best sushi we have had in a very long time. The prawn tempura was also an absolute highlight of our meal. A special thank you to our server, Carles, who was incredibly attentive and made sure everything was perfect from start to finish. We will definitely be back.

reviews.author: Sarah Cowan
reviews.text: It felt like I was back in Japan. What an amazing find. The food was amazing. We sat at bar and they handed us hand rolls to eat and it was a great experience. Everything was so delicious including the drinks! Can’t wait to come back

reviews.author: Nikita Patel
reviews.text: Extremely disappointed in the service we received. We had a reservation for 6, it took them such a long time to take our order. Once we ordered our bottle of white wine it took such a long time to come. One of our glasses was cracked and the wine came warm so we sent it back and requested a cold one which took around 30 minutes to come. By this time we were so fed up because NO waiter came to take our order for food or attend to us. The service overall was practically nonexistent. There seemed to be a huge focus on influencers and people filming with cameras, flashlights, and content setups, while our table was repeatedly ignored. It genuinely felt like unless you were there creating content, you weren’t a priority. We had also specifically asked to sit at the bar but were instead given a regular table, despite having a reservation. To make matters worse, the bathrooms were disgusting and clearly had not been maintained. Between the 40-minute wait, cracked glassware, dirty bathrooms, and lack of service, the experience was terrible from start to finish. Would not recommend. DO NOT GO IF YOU AREN’T AN INFLUENCER.
